title: The Crab Derby, 2017
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Thirty-third annual. Gully's girl draws it again; she's seven; the crab has eight legs now. She's been counting.

panels.composition: Gully's. The girl, seven, on the crate, drawing. WOOD lettering beside her. GULLY. BARNABY II.

balloons.text: Eight. I counted. At the tide pool.

image.prompt: a seven-year-old girl on a crate drawing a crab on a flyer with a marker while a thin man letters beside her, a man in an apron, a three-legged dog, clean ink

panels.composition: Her crab. Eight legs. Two claws. Correct. Still smiling.

image.prompt: close-up of a child's marker drawing of a crab with exactly eight legs and two claws, smiling

panels.composition: Wood looking at it a long time. Gully watching him look.

image.prompt: a thin man studying a child's drawing while a man in an apron watches him with a small smile

panels.composition: Twenty flyers. The twentieth: eight legs. The girl pins it herself, standing on the crate. The twenty stays in Gully's pocket; the strip stops tracking it.

image.prompt: a small girl standing on a crate pinning a crab flyer at the end of a row of twenty on a shingle wall, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: Eight legs. 'She's better than I am.' The twenty stops being tracked.
